summary: The proposal is missing several mandatory sections, contains too few peer‑reviewed references, and fails key requirements for figures and schedule. Critical structural and compliance issues must be resolved before submission.

findings.title: Missing required sections
findings.description: The proposal lacks the mandatory sections: Introduction, Motivation, Objective, and AI Transparency Statement.

findings.title: Insufficient bibliography entries
findings.description: Only 5 peer‑reviewed publications are listed; at least 6‑8 are required.

findings.title: Not enough figures
findings.description: The proposal includes only one figure; at least two diagrams/mockups are required.

locations.quote: Figure 1: Depiction of the top‑level workfow of the interactions in relation to Artemis and GitLab CI

findings.title: Missing UML diagram
findings.description: The sole figure is a workflow diagram, not a suitable UML diagram (class, activity, component).

locations.quote: Figure 1: Depiction of the top‑level workfow of the interactions in relation to Artemis and GitLab CI

findings.title: Figure not referenced in text
findings.description: Figure 1 is never cited in the main text (e.g., 'Figure 1 shows…'), violating the requirement that every figure be referenced.

locations.quote: Figure 1: Depiction of the top‑level workfow of the interactions in relation to Artemis and GitLab CI

findings.title: Thesis writing tasks in schedule
findings.description: The schedule lists activities such as working on the thesis and a generic 'Writing …' entry, which are prohibited.

locations.quote: Every week, Wednesday is set aside for working on the thesis.

findings.title: Schedule iterations too short
findings.description: The schedule divides work into weekly items (<2 weeks), whereas iterations must be 2‑4 weeks long.

locations.quote: 5th week: Proposal … 2nd week: Docker GitLab CI Runner configuration …

findings.title: Requirements‑gathering sprint in schedule
findings.description: The schedule contains a dedicated 'Requirements' task, which is not allowed in an agile‑style schedule.

findings.title: Forbidden sentence starter
findings.description: Sentence begins with 'Since', which is prohibited by the writing style rules.

locations.quote: Since some Version Control (VC) systems include a Continuous Integration (CI) application, it is possible to reduce the efort required to maintain the servers...
